verses.text: This is the family line of Jesus the Messiah, descendant of David and Abraham.
Abraham was Isaac’s father; Isaac was Jacob’s father; Jacob was Judah and his brothers’ father.
Judah and Tamar had Perez and Zerah. Perez was Hezron’s father, and Hezron was Ram’s father.
Ram was Amminadab’s father; Amminadab, Nahshon’s; and Nahshon, Salmon’s.
Salmon and Rahab had Boaz. Boaz and Ruth had Obed, and Obed was Jesse’s father.
Jesse was King David’s father. David was Solomon’s father through the woman who had been Uriah’s wife.
Solomon was Rehoboam’s father; Rehoboam was Abijah’s; and Abijah was Asa’s.
Asa was Jehoshaphat’s father; Jehoshaphat was Joram’s; and Joram was Uzziah’s.
Uzziah was Jotham’s father; Jotham was Ahaz’s; and Ahaz was Hezekiah’s.
Hezekiah was Manasseh’s father; Manasseh was Amon’s; and Amon was Josiah’s.
Josiah was Jechoniah and his brothers’ father around the time Israel was exiled to Babylon.
After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah was Shealtiel’s father, and Shealtiel was Zerubbabel’s.
Zerubbabel was Abiud’s father; Abiud was Eliakim’s; Eliakim was Azor’s.
Azor was Zadok’s father; Zadok was Achim’s; and Achim was Eliud’s.
Eliud was Eleazar’s father; Eleazar was Matthan’s; and Matthan was Jacob’s.
Jacob was Joseph’s father. Joseph was Mary’s husband, and Mary gave birth to Jesus, who is called the Messiah.
So there were fourteen generations from Abraham to David, fourteen from David to the exile in Babylon, and fourteen from the exile to the Messiah.
This is how the birth of Jesus the Messiah happened: His mother Mary was engaged to Joseph, but before they came together, she was found to be pregnant through the Holy Spirit.
Joseph, her husband, was a righteous man. He didn’t want to expose her publicly, so he planned to end the engagement quietly.

While he was thinking it over, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take Mary as your wife. The child conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.
She will give birth to a son. Name him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.”
All of this happened to fulfill what the Lord had spoken through the prophet:
“Look, the virgin will become pregnant and give birth to a son. They will call him Immanuel”—which means “God with us.”
When Joseph woke up, he did what the Lord’s angel had commanded and took Mary as his wife.
But he didn’t sleep with her until she had given birth to her firstborn son. Joseph named him Jesus.
